subject: STABLE api-surface-sonnet #7 (gate-green 05:00): tessellation runtime, arg-buffer layer, linked functions, residency, refusals
body:
GATE-GREEN at 05:00 on the tree as of these hashes (run_host_tests rc=0 incl. strict bundle link; api_surface_frontend_test ASan+UBSan PASS; tessellator_test PASS; texture_format_frontend_test PASS; metal_resource_integration --candidate from work/: only the known CoreAnimation render pass stride oracle fails, everything else ok; iOS arm64 -Wall -Wextra -Werror compile of compute_frontend.m clean). Logs gpu/build/api-surface-20261027/gates/{run_host_tests2,api_asan,integration,texture_format}.log, hashes SHA256SUMS.short there.
Hashes: compute_frontend.m d373b98b, render_encoder.inc bd787b21, runtime_pipeline.inc 924226bf, compute_descriptor.inc 15c6683d, api_surface.inc e8be8dc7, api_events.inc 15b20072, api_parallel.inc 2fdc63e4, api_tess.inc cae90f71, tessellator.h 2cfe7404, api_argbuf.inc a59aa3a7, api_encoder_refusals.inc b0f751de, ws_selector_compat.inc 3bb65da4, nord2_metal_bridge.c 8f2f10e6, nord2_metal_bridge.h 39b9db7d, api_surface_host_test.inc 4be9cc6f, tests/api_surface_frontend_test.py 4b95745b, tests/tessellator_test.py e0adff29, tools/run_host_tests.sh 14f0e126.
Since #6: (a) argument buffers: n2mb_buffer_va (bridge, 8 additive lines + decl) + MTLBuffer.gpuAddress + MTLArgumentEncoder for explicit descriptors (buffers + constants; textures/samplers/function-derived refused) - NOT claimed to work on a device until the kernel handle-list/cache contract and the compiler's pointer-load model are agreed with shader-coverage-opus; (b) useResource/useHeap retain for the command's life (compute+render; removed the 3 silent no-op bodies from ws_selector_compat.inc); (c) tessellation stream now follows the create_tessellated contract (patch, instance+base, cp indices, position), drawIndexedPatches with control point index buffer implemented; (d) linked function link_name (specializedName) marshalled; (e) refusal stubs for pipeline-state/texture/sampler/device families (gpuResourceID=0 etc).
IF ANY HUNK MUST BE EXCLUDED for C6m: the self-contained opt-outs are (1) argument buffers = api_argbuf.inc + the two lines in api_surface.inc (include, gpuAddress/newArgumentEncoderWithArguments:) + bridge n2mb_buffer_va + TeguBuffer.gpuVA ivar; (2) tessellation = api_tess.inc + tessellator.h + 4 ivars/1 dealloc release in render_encoder.inc (inert without a tess pipeline: tegu_pipeline_tess_info returns NULL). Otherwise land all. I stop editing shared files at 05:45 and will only touch my new files / the ledger after that.
